pool_name.description: Name of the pool — must be unique and alphanumeric (no spaces). Appears in process titles and log prefixes.

listen_address.description: Address (host:port) or absolute path to Unix socket (e.g., /run/php-fpm/www.sock) for this pool to listen on.

user.description: User account under which PHP-FPM worker processes run. Should have minimal privileges needed by the application.

group.description: Group for worker processes. Typically matches the user's primary group.

listen_owner.description: Unix socket owner (user). Only used if listen_address is a Unix socket.

listen_group.description: Unix socket group. Only used if listen_address is a Unix socket.

listen_mode.description: Unix socket file mode (octal). Controls read/write permissions for owner, group, and others.

process_manager.description: Process management strategy: 'static', 'dynamic', or 'ondemand'. Determines how worker processes are spawned.

pm_max_children.description: Maximum number of child processes (used by static and ondemand pools). Must be ≥1. Higher = more concurrency but more memory.

pm_start_servers.description: Number of child processes to create on startup (dynamic pools only).

pm_min_spare_servers.description: Minimum idle servers to keep ready (dynamic pools only).

pm_max_spare_servers.description: Maximum idle servers to keep ready (dynamic pools only).

pm_request_terminate_timeout.description: Number of seconds after which a worker process is terminated if it’s still processing a request.

pm_log_level.description: Verbosity level of the pool’s log. Options: alert, error, warning, notice, debug.

access_log_path.description: Path to the pool’s access log. Use 'syslog' to log to the system log daemon. Supports % macros (e.g., %p for pool name).

access_format.description: Format string for access log entries. Use PHP-FPM’s predefined tokens (e.g., %R for remote IP, %u for user).

slowlog_path.description: Path to the slow request log. Empty string disables slowlog. Supports % macros like access.log.

request_slowlog_timeout.description: Seconds after which a request is considered slow and logged. Set to 0 to disable slow request logging.

php_admin_values.description: PHP ini settings that override system defaults (cannot be changed at runtime). Keys are ini names, values are strings.

php_values.description: Additional PHP ini settings (php_value), can sometimes be overridden in user scripts (e.g., .user.ini).

php_env_vars.description: Environment variables to set for each worker process. Each element is an object with 'name' and 'value'.

chroot.description: Chroot directory. If non-empty, all relative paths become relative to this directory. Empty for no chroot.

chdir.description: Working directory to change to after startup. Usually a path to the application root.

process_priority.description: Nice priority for worker processes (string, e.g., '10' or '-5'). Blank leaves it unchanged.

process_prefix.description: Prefix for process titles. Useful for distinguishing pools in 'ps' output.

rlimit_files.description: File descriptor limit per worker process (soft limit). Higher values support many concurrent connections.

rlimit_core.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of core dump files. Set to 'unlimited' or '0' to disable or use system default.

disable_functions.description: Comma-separated list of PHP functions to disable (e.g., 'exec,passthru,shell_exec').

disable_classes.description: Comma-separated list of PHP classes to disable.

open_basedir.description: Colon-separated list of allowed paths for file operations. Restricts file access to these directories for security.

catch_workers_output.description: Whether to redirect worker stdout/stderr to the main FPM log. Use 'yes' to capture early startup errors or echo statements.
